title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 41,788 Official Dossiers Across 39 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 41,788 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 956 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 39 active jurisdictions: United States (15,490 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (3,100 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,386 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,339 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,996 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (188 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,321 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,179 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (190 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (514 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (73 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (78 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (423 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (99 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (36 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (189 dossiers | Catalog), Bahrain (33 dossiers | Catalog), China (40 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (43 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (42 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (47 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (17 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
